name: os-shell
description: OS Shell — thin browser-hosted runtime for web apps and Digiconomy-native apps. Not a primitive.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @osshell/contract && npm run build -w @osshell/runtime && npm run build -w @osshell/sdk && npm run build -w @osshell/web
scripts.build:os-experience: node scripts/write-ox-update-manifest.mjs && npm run build -w @digiconomy/xperience-contract && npm run build -w @digiconomy/xperience-sdk && npm run build -w @digiconomy/os-experience
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @osshell/contract && npm run typecheck -w @osshell/contract && npm run typecheck -w @osshell/runtime && npm run typecheck -w @osshell/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @osshell/web && npm run typecheck -w @osshell/demo-notes
scripts.test: npm run build -w @osshell/contract && npm run build -w @osshell/runtime && npm run build -w @osshell/sdk && node --import tsx --test packages/contract/test/*.test.ts packages/runtime/test/*.test.ts
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w @osshell/web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.android:experience:sync: npm run build:os-experience && npm run cap:sync:android -w @digiconomy/os-experience
scripts.android:experience:release: npm run android:experience:sync && cd apps/os-experience/android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.ios:experience:sync: npm run build:os-experience && npm run cap:sync:ios -w @digiconomy/os-experience
scripts.os-experience:build: npm run build:os-experience && npm run cap:sync -w @digiconomy/os-experience
scripts.build:xperience: npm run build -w @digiconomy/xperience-contract && npm run build -w @digiconomy/xperience-sdk && node scripts/prisma-xperience.mjs generate && npm run build -w @digiconomy/xperience-api && npm run build -w @digiconomy/xperience-console && npm run build -w @digiconomy/xperience-mobile && npm run build -w @digiconomy/os-experience
scripts.typecheck:xperience: npm run typecheck -w @digiconomy/xperience-contract && npm run typecheck -w @digiconomy/xperience-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @digiconomy/xperience-ui && node scripts/prisma-xperience.mjs generate && npm run typecheck -w @digiconomy/xperience-api && npm run typecheck -w @digiconomy/xperience-console && npm run typecheck -w @digiconomy/xperience-mobile && npm run typecheck -w @digiconomy/os-experience
scripts.test:xperience: npm run build -w @digiconomy/xperience-contract && npm run build -w @digiconomy/xperience-sdk && node scripts/prisma-xperience.mjs generate && node --test-concurrency=1 --import tsx --test packages/xperience-contract/test/*.test.ts packages/xperience-ui/test/*.test.ts api/test/*.test.ts scripts/xperience-architecture-guard.test.mjs
scripts.test:xperience:browser: npm run build -w @digiconomy/xperience-contract && npm run build -w @digiconomy/xperience-sdk && npm run build -w @digiconomy/os-experience && node scripts/prisma-xperience.mjs generate && node --test-concurrency=1 --import tsx --test api/test/browser-workflow.test.ts api/test/consumer-browser.test.ts api/test/os-experience-web.test.ts
